title: From Evidence to Judgment: Trace-Augmented Reasoning under Conflicting Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2512.16795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieved documents often disagree, contain outdated information, or fail to support any answer, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have no reliable way to decide which documents to trust. We treat this as a reasoning problem and test it separately from answer generation. We release 943 training and validation examples and a disjoint 736-example benchmark, and fine-tune four language models to write a structured think trace before answering: the model judges each document, infers the conflict pattern, and writes a grounded answer or a justified refusal. Our evaluation framework, CATS (Conflict-Aware Trust Score), scores grounded refusal, behavioural adherence, factual grounding, and single-truth recall; a human study validates factual grounding and single-truth recall (kappa=0.78 and 0.79). translated_title: 从证据到判断：冲突证据下的轨迹增强推理
translated_abstract: 检索到的文档常常相互矛盾、包含过时信息或无法支持任何答案，而检索增强生成（RAG）系统缺乏可靠的方式来决定应信任哪些文档。我们将这一问题视为一个推理问题，并将其与答案生成分开进行测试。我们发布了943个训练与验证样例以及一个与之不相交的736个样例的基准数据集，并对四个语言模型进行微调，使其在回答之前写出结构化的思考轨迹：模型对每篇文档进行评判，推断冲突模式，然后写出有依据的答案或经过论证的拒绝回答。我们的评估框架CATS（冲突感知信任分数）对有依据的拒绝、行为一致性、事实依据性和单一真值召回率进行评分；一项人类研究验证了事实依据性和单一真值召回率（kappa=0.78和0.79）。思考轨迹提升了“回答/拒绝”决策：在全部三种提示设置下，未经微调的模型的拒绝F1分数最高仅为0.429（……原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在RAG面临冲突证据时，通过微调模型在回答前生成结构化思考轨迹（逐篇评判文档、推断冲突模式）来增强推理，并发布了相关数据集、基准及CATS评估框架，证明该方法显著提升了模型在有依据地回答或拒绝之间的决策能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces trace-augmented reasoning for RAG under conflicting evidence, where fine-tuned models write structured think traces (judging each document and inferring conflict patterns) before answering, and releases a dataset, benchmark, and the CATS evaluation framework, showing this approach substantially improves grounded answer/refuse decisions.
